purpose: Study early KSGT syntax signatures of generated prose at paragraph level without equating anti-template frequency with Korean naturalness.
unit: Entire Korean two-paragraph writing response (not individual replacement and not AI detector label).

proxies.method: Sentence Unicode-length mean/variance, paragraph count and per-paragraph sentence counts
proxies.semantic_limit: Sentence length is not rhythm perception.

proxies.method: Exact listed connective surface counts: 그러나 그렇지만 따라서 이러한 결국 또한 다만 특히
proxies.semantic_limit: A connective token is not a proof of discourse misuse.

proxies.method: Regex-only candidate A가 아니라 B / 단순히 A를 넘어서 B, list exact hit offsets for review
proxies.semantic_limit: Contrast is often legitimate; must inspect actual prior proposition and relation.

proxies.method: Surface sentence terminal suffix histogram 다 / 요 / 습니다 / punctuation / other
proxies.semantic_limit: Cannot infer stance or politeness from isolated ending without discourse/social relation.

proxies.method: Word-form diversity and abstract-term candidate counts using tiny frozen vocabulary
Count consecutive sentence openings with first 3 visible whitespace tokens identical
proxies.semantic_limit: Repetition may be rhetorically motivated, no negative score.

permitted_comparisons: Descriptive by brief and genre for B/A/K; no p-value or humanlike index.
prohibited: Develop ad hoc blacklist after seeing K output
Optimize generation prompts based on same six sources
Infer language production ontology from six hand-authored briefs
